title: August and the Tide
author: Lior Reyes
blurb: Lena Quintana, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
